report:
[ORACLE] Signal doesn't work anymore

Hi everyone,
Is it possible that the signal behavior has changed in newer versions? After updating to version 3.1.1, signal no longer works; before, it worked fine. The configuration hasn't been changed.
I'm working with SourceSignalChannel and I can see that the message is also being transmitted and entered into the corresponding topic.
In the log, I see that the signal processor has been started. However, it isn't picking up the message.
I'm using Oracle 19c and the parameter is set as follows:
signal.data.collection: MYDB.WORLD.DEBEZIUM.DEBEZIUM_SIGNAL
signal.enabled.channels: Source
Does anyone have an idea what I'm doing wrong?
Cheers
Johann

evidence.quote: Are you setting `signal.data.collection` with the quoted database name ... It doesn't seem from the logs the table matching is working"; reporter: "You were absolutely right.

notes: Signals stopped after upgrade, reads like a regression; the fix was quoting the dotted global db name in signal.data.collection. Signal table matching code settles it.
